Question: How do I make a crying girlfriend to laugh?
Answer: Grab a knife 🔪 and tell her laugh or else… Just kidding. You don't make a person who's crying to laugh suddenly. There's no point in that. Try to understand what is making her cry. Step in her shoes and try to console her. Give her, her space , but show your concern. Understand and respect her emotions, if you're physically available, give her a hug. After this if you sense (timing is the key my friend) that she's getting better, you can crack up a joke on how she is looking like a baby (preferably a child which you both know and find cute) or any cute thing she likes. You know your girlfriends choices better. In any case, just respect her feeling and giver her the space or the attention she needs at the moment. Best wishes.

Question: What motivates you to study and why?

Question: Will a smoker’s lungs clean themselves if they quit smoking and how long does it take?
Answer: The latest scientific research says “Yes!” Who conducted the research? The research was carried out by Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute, University College London and Kyoto University in Japan. It was published in Nature journal. The research took genetic samples from 16 people consisting of 3 children, 4 people who never smoked, 3 current smokers and 6 ex smokers (who smoked about a pack of cigarette everyday for about 40 years). What was found in the research? It was found that current smokers had more than 2 times probability of cancer than the people who never smoked. Scientists were surprised that , smokers upon quitting seemed to develop the protective cells which were dormant during smoking to protect itself from the harm of tobacco. The damaged cells due to smoking consisted of 90–96% of total lung cells. Our heroes , the remaining 4–10% remained inactive, protecting themselves from tobacco. Maybe like Shield of Captain America. When people quit smoking, those dormant cells (protective cells) developed , multiplied itself and formed 20–40% of total lung cells. These new generated cells were exactly like the cells of people who never smoked (termed normal lung cells) This can be further explained from the picture below: (Picture Credits: Sanger) In the above picture, White lung cells can be taken as good cells while pink can be taken as damaged ones. From the research it seems like nature is keeping its reserved army which is able to regenerate and multiply itself. How long does it take to recover? It depends on the quantum of damage. 4–5 years can be taken in the safer side. How to go forward with recovery? These best practices can be followed. What are your experiences? Question: How safe is it to travel to Varanasi alone since I have never travelled alone earlier?
Answer: Very safe but follow certain precautions! I have been living in Varanasi since 2017 and I do feel qualified to answer this question a an ex-outsider and a current local. (Kal Bhairao Temple) After entering Varanasi, it is a tradition to take blessings from Kal Bhairao. Kal bhairao is believed to be the Kotwal (Police Officer) of Varanasi. I suppose you’re planning to stay for a few days in Varanasi. You can get any guest house at reasonable prices near the Ghats and surrounding areas. They are well maintained and reasonably secure. You can visit our Nepali Dharmashaala as well, if you’re tight on budget. You can DM me on Instagram (Link in bio) (Nepali Mandir and Nepali Dharmashaalaa) What are the precautions? 1.Beware of people offering you intoxicants: Often, it might lead you getting robbed. 2. Don’t take pictures of cremation: Respect Hindu tradition and the family of the deceased. Locals can demand heavy price and might throw away your camera in the river as well. 3. Don’t take bath alone: When you decide to take a dip in Ganga river, make sure the locals are around. What happens is due to increase in water level, the temples and the structures besides the stairs of the Ghat get submerged in the water. Many people , mostly who don’t know swimming and some experienced swimmers have also drowned getting stuck. (Picture source: Pinterest) You see, water levels rises above that as well, and there might be many such structures beneath where there are high chances of getting stuck. 4. Its not city for nightlife: It is advisable not to take a stroll especially around the narrow streets late at night. You might encounter with drunkards, angry cows and bulls. Cows are specially irritated at night when they’re trying to take rest. 5. Be aware of Food choices: Make sure the food is piping hot and served fresh. Be aware if you have leaky gut or any other problems, since the food here consists a lot of masala, a lot of ghee but a lot of love as well. 6. Beware of high prices: If you’re planning to take the boat ride, don’t get surprised to hear ridiculous price. A fair thing to do is to ask the local tea-seller about the prices of the boat ride while enjoying your cup of tea. And, you’ll be asked a ridiculous price for sarees also. I find Golghar sarees to be of best quality and value for money. You can check them out online as well: Buy Designer Ethnic Wear from Banaras | golghar.org They’re just near Kal Bhairao Temple, remember, the Kotwal of the city. So, is Varanasi safe for solo travel? Absolutely yes. You’ll get one of the most amazing experiences of your life. Varanasi is the city of Shiva, The Mahākāla. Mahākāla means beyond time and death, and Varanasi, one of the oldest city of the world, also justifies it fully. Happy travelling. Har Har Mahadev!

Question: What should everyone know about weight loss?
Answer: I lost around 30 Kgs (around 66 lbs) in 1.5 years and have helped many others achieve this feat. There are many experiences that fellow Quorans have shared, these are my learnings. 1.Scales are deceiving: One kg of Fat has way more volume than a kg of Muscle. Don’t get upset if the weight is not decreasing or sometimes it may spike up. Just check how you’re feeling and check if the size is decreasing and muscle is getting toned. (Picture source: Google/Quora) 2. A proper workout routine: Most of the times, beginners in workout do what they feel like doing. Please keep in mind that we should regularly level up the workout because after sometimes, our body gets used to the workout. A properly planned workout program will appropriately tax all the muscle groups and the best part is that a workout program will make you stick to the routine. Here is the free 30 day beginner workout program that I have my friends follow: FREE 30 Day Home Workout For Beginners To Lose Weight If you’re interested in Yoga: Get Your 30 Days Beginner's Yoga Program (I’m currently making 90 Days Intermediate workout program as well, check out my bio to get updated) You can follow my space on Quora for regular updates: Ayurveda Center I post regular updates on my website as well : Lunar Pins - Holistic Health And Wellness You can reach out on Instagram or Pinterest, if you’re in a recovery process, from weight loss to recovering from any illness. I’d love to help. 3. Rest is a must: Most of the times, we skip rest days. Our body should work in cycle of rest and stress. We should plan rest between the workouts in such a way that the muscles get ample time for recovery. I have personally experienced my body looking way more toned and ripped in my recovery period. A good workout program will take care of this. And this will help you prevent from unnecessary injuries. 4. Diet : While going through internet you’ll find yourself surrounded with fad diets. Try everything but choose a diet which you will enjoy and can sustain for a longer period of time. Fitness is a continuous process, its not a destination, rather a journey. It can take a lot of time, and if you don’t enjoy the process, you’ll definitely quit sooner or later. Eat your greens, fresh vegetables and at times, eat those delicious desserts. I follow Intermittent Fasting and have reaped a lot of benefits from it. And personally, I don’t count any calories, either macros or micros. I make sure, I take ample amount of Green vegetables and fresh fruits and a modest amount of nuts and other food. I’ve written an answer on Intermittent Fasting here on Quora: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya's answer to Is it still healthy to do intermittent fasting every day, like just eating once a day? 5. Surround yourself with positive people: There will be times where the process will get the best of us. Being with like minded people will certainly help sail through the process. Weight loss should never be a painful process. Make it enjoyable, the benefits of being fit is way more than the little pain of small discipline you have to follow. And remember, weight loss is not a destination, its a continuous process, just like brushing your teeth. Wishing you good health and a good life.
